title: Council on Aging four-year plan
summary: The office will spend the next couple of weeks gathering and analyzing survey data, then turn to objectives for the County's four-year area plan on aging. Review of survey data starts in September, and drafting of objectives starts in November. Staff will set up a focus group with the disability community and tell council members the schedule.

timeline.text: In the next couple of weeks, the office will gather and analyze survey data and then work on objectives for the four-year plan.
Council members will be told the focus group schedule once it is set.
Office staff will reach out to set up a focus group with the disability community.
